heading: Administrative support services
lead: The Administrator of General Services shall provide administrative support services for the Commission on a reimbursable basis.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Dec. 16, 1967, see section 220(a)(1) of Pub. L. 90–206, set out as a note under section 3110 of Title 5, Government Organization and Employees.
